description: Nvidia Nemotron 3.5 30B A3B Q5_K_S by bartowski
gpu_tip: ~26GB total. An 8GB GPU (e.g. RX 7600) plus ~24GB of DDR5 system RAM covers it — Nemotron 3.5's hybrid architecture means the full 262K context adds almost nothing on top.
mac_tip: Needs ~26GB — fits a 32GB MacBook Pro comfortably.
